heading: 4 Interventions
text: 2 stages protocol: 1) Screening Day screening assessments; 2) Day , DayB, Day C consist computational exercise tasks, questionnaires, blood draw. Participants complete two stages across 4 separate days. Day , Day B, Day C occur randomly, spaced 6-8 days apart.

heading: 4.1 Screening Day stage
text: Screening Day stage, participants undergo structured clinical interview assess current eating disorder symptoms, psychological symptoms,cognitive function assessment, physical status, demographics. participants 18 years old, parents also asked complete demographics form. heading: 4.2 Day A, Day B, and Day C Stage
